text: INTERPRETER seal crossing (spec §11 S3, TaintPort §1.2): call_fn_in_general's sealed instantiation goes through call_fn_sealed (seal_call, dict_edge_in on the way in, with_frame under the callee's provenance and pin owner, catchable/abortable sticky, dict_edge_out on the way out); call_fn_frame casts params (bind_params_sealed, fn_cx per activation, t_pins TYP strip, a sealed frame's params take ALL) and the return (seal_ret); call_mut_with's sealed path casts the &mut hand-back (replaced_ok_top); the closure frame casts arguments and result across the seal (closure_args_check/closure_ret_check, param_types pins, dict edges); handler frames carry sealed/operator_frames/pin_owner, arms run through handler_edge_into/back under with_frame and handler_may_answer gates the replay feed; dict_set/dict_remove/dict_inc mark dict_mutated; sandbox_run casts a sealed fn's result to i64; goal_eval and sandbox_run refuse a sealed caller with the uniform no_such_fn text. Every addition is gated on seal.active or the T=true instantiation; unsealed path unchanged. Every sealed run is still refused (SEAL_RUNTIME_COMPLETE = false)
